h.select_rule: Keep hypotheses you rate at least 55% likely true but expect other models to rate below 50%, and name the specific naive reasoning that would mislead them. Drop anything you rate below 50% yourself, and anything obvious from structure alone. Keep fields and directions diverse.
h.strategy: Propose a broad, varied set of conditional hypotheses covering many different edited fields, conditioning fields and both directions. For each, briefly note your own probability that it holds and how an intuitive reader would judge it.

hyps.why: Replacing conv3x3 with skip loses capacity, so the effect is worse than when replacing other ops.
Diminishing returns: another strong parallel path to the output reduces the marginal conv gain on the direct edge.
Diminishing returns: a conv3x3 into the output on another path reduces the gain from the direct edge.
Diminishing returns: a conv3x3 on the parallel direct path reduces the benefit of another conv path.
Pooling on an empty edge adds a path, whereas replacing a conv or skip with pooling loses.
Adding skip to an empty edge helps, while replacing a conv with skip hurts.
Replacing conv3x3 with skip is a loss compared with replacing none.
Removing the conv3x3 on the input edge to node 1 is very damaging.
